subject: MSA & Order Form — preflight party checklist and template gap capture
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@novaworks.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MSA & Order Form — preflight party checklist and template gap capture

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As we prepare to circulate our initial edits, can you confirm the following so the legal team can start a scoped review instead of a full redline pass? If we have these items it will shorten turn time.

Requested items (short checklist):
- Full legal entity name for contracting (including DBA, if any)
- Invoice remit address and billing contact (name/email)
- Any required SOC2/infosec evidence or attestation pointers we should include in the PO
- The specific Order Form variant your procurement team expects (SaaS standard / Enterprise addendum / Marketplace purchase)
- Whether you need language on data residency or additional export controls

Also attaching our standard MSA + order form template links for reference. If you already have a counterparty MSA, please send the current file and mark non-starters so we can highlight them in our first pass.

Goal: produce a prioritized short-list of clause gaps (liability, data, IP, billing) by Monday and return a marked-up doc with comment threads for negotiation.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MSA_template_v3.0.docx (docx)], [Attachment: Redwood_OrderForm_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124

From: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@novaworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps Team <legalops@novaworks.com>, procurement@novaworks.com
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — preflight party checklist and template gap capture

Marcus —

Thanks — attaching the most recent MSA and the Order Form our legal/procurement teams prefer. Quick answers inline:

- Legal entity: NovaWorks, Inc. (DBA: NovaWorks Analytics)
- Billing contact: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@novaworks.com>, invoices@novaworks.com, remit address: 1208 Harbor Ave, Suite 220, San Diego, CA 92101
- SOC2: We will need SOC2 Type II report; we can provide a one-page attestation and link to our vendor portal.
- Order Form variant: Please use "Enterprise addendum" version (attached NW_OrderForm_template.xlsx).
- Data residency: US only for this procurement (no EEA requirements).

Attached: NovaWorks_Counterparty_MSA_v1.2.docx, NW_OrderForm_template.xlsx, party-contact-sheet.csv

We flagged two items we view as non-starters in the MSA:
1) Unlimited IP indemnity for customer-created models (we've highlighted)
2) Broad export control language that extends beyond US/UK compliance (we've proposed a trimmed clause)

We'd appreciate Redwood's initial positions on: liability cap, security incident notification SLA, and whether you can accept our standard data deletion/extract protocol.

Evelyn Rogers
Director, Strategic Procurement
NovaWorks
evelyn.rogers@novaworks.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@novaworks.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — preflight party checklist and template gap capture

Marcus / Karthik —

Thanks for forwarding the counterparty materials. I reviewed NovaWorks_MSA_v1.2 briefly and pulled a short priority list for contracting/legal so we can scope the first redline pass:

Priority topics for initial pass (high-level):
- Liability cap: NovaWorks proposes unlimited for certain IP claims; propose starting with a 3x fees cap + carveouts for gross negligence
- IP indemnity: Customer-sourced models and derivative IP need explicit carveouts; our standard language should be circulated
- Security incident SLA/notification: they asked for incident SLAs; confirm what we can commit to operationally (notification windows, containment updates)
- Data deletion: they have a specific extract-and-delete workflow — need engineering sign-off on retention/extract timing
- Export controls: narrow to jurisdictions we support; reject overly broad language

Action items I can take this morning:
1) Draft a concise redline (tracked changes) that highlights the three non-starter points and proposes Redwood's baseline positions.
2) Produce an internal one-pager with recommended concessions and an escalation path if NovaWorks wants deeper changes.

Marcus — can you confirm the customer's procurement cadence (target PO/contract signing window)? I want to prioritize items we must concede vs. items for round-two negotiation.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Rogers <evelyn.rogers@novaworks.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — preflight party checklist and template gap capture

Evelyn — thanks for the files and the flags. Timing: NovaWorks is targeting a signed order by EOD Thursday (2026-12-09) to hit their Q4 provisioning window. That gives us a compressed timeline but still workable.

Planned next steps:
- Vanessa will circulate a tracked redline of the MSA by Monday morning (Dec 7); Karthik will validate the Order Form yields and billing exhibit.
- I'll confirm with Sophie (billing) and procurement on any PO templates they require and push for a shared DocuSign envelope to keep signatures synchronized.
- We'll surface any high-cost concessions to you two before we propose changes back to NovaWorks.

Evelyn — can you confirm Sophie Tran is the primary signer for billing and whether legalops wants me to loop anyone else from finance? If you prefer, we can set a 30-min call Monday after Vanessa's redline to walk through the major items.

Thanks —
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0124
